caseNameFull: Brooklyn Trust Co., Trustee v. Kelby
attorneys: Messrs. Jackson A. Dykman and Ralph W. Crolly for petitioner. Messrs. Charles II. Kelby and Charles M. McCarty for Prudence-Bonds Corp. et al.; and Mr. Samuel Silbiger for George E. Eddy,— respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied. Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or *768decision of this application.

Messrs. Jackson A. Dykman and Ralph W. Crolly for petitioner. Messrs. Charles II. Kelby and Charles M. McCarty for Prudence-Bonds Corp. et al.; and Mr. Samuel Silbiger for George E. Eddy,— respondents.
